name: Comar's Heart
summary: In the Undercity, warlocks seek Comar's Heart to draw a succubus into their service. The heart belonged to Comar Villard, a human searching the Wetlands for his lost wife.

sections.title: A Beacon of Purity
sections.body: Comar Villard keeps searching the Wetlands for his lost wife. Though turmoil has swept the Eastern Kingdoms, he refuses to abandon the search. Carendin Halgar's disciples in the Undercity judge his fidelity among the rarest and purest. To bind a succubus, a creature both capricious and predatory, warlocks need devotion like his as bait. Comar's steadfast love marks him for slaughter, and his heart becomes the lure for a demonic servant.

sections.title: The Price of Seduction
sections.body: Forsaken apprentices must travel south through contested lands, cross the Thandol Span, and enter marshes held by the Alliance to claim Comar's Heart. They carry it back to the Temple of the Damned with Dalin's Heart. The organ looks ordinary, though goodness once drove the man it belonged to. To the Nether, the virtue left in Comar's flesh is intoxicating bait. It can draw a succubus across the dimensional veil and into a warlock's thrall.

faq.answer: Comar Villard was a devoted human who searched the dangerous Wetlands for his missing wife. He would not give up hope, and his love marked him as a pure-hearted man.

faq.q: Why do warlocks need Comar's Heart?
faq.answer: Warlocks of the Undercity need Comar's Heart to lure and bind a succubus. His devotion makes the heart irresistible bait for the demon.
Comar Villard wanders the main road in the northern Wetlands, just south of the Thandol Span between Arathi Highlands and Khaz Modan.

faq.q: Who sends warlocks to collect the heart?
aliases: who gives hearts of the pure
faq.answer: Warlock trainers in the Undercity direct apprentices to collect the heart. Carendin Halgar oversees them in the Temple of the Damned, where the apprentices learn to summon a succubus.

angles.text: As a warlock, taking Comar's Heart shows how demonology turns mortal virtue into bait for a succubus you mean to bind.
As one of the Forsaken, harvesting the heart of a loyal human lover shows the emotional severance between the living and the undead in Lordaeron.
